options.content: **How to read these.** The gateway rates each vital with the specification's thresholds, the same ones that color these panels. A p75 counts every consented session, not only those the trace sampler kept. Each vital is reported once per view ("Once per view" in the specification), so a long-lived view contributes one sample, not one per interaction.
